prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Postpone sign-in after pet adoption: Move sign-in step to after adoption certificate screen so users personalize their pet before creating or logging into an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Carousel redesign for pet selection: Redesign the pet selection screen into a full visual carousel featuring rich card previews of pre-made pets.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Choose Your Companion", "body": "Browse and pick a ready-to-play pet to join you on your desktop right away."}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop control tutorial screen: Add a dedicated interactive guide screen before finishing onboarding that demonstrates desktop controls and tray icon access.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_guide", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_guide": {"headline": "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Use the system tray icon to hide, feed, or talk to your pet anytime while working.", "layout": "checklist"}}
3: [home, new_flow] Animated desktop setup progress flow: Rebuild the waiting screen to display step-by-step progress bars and estimated remaining time while pet assets load.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Pet Workspace", "body": "We are setting up your pet's desktop rendering and animations. This will only take a moment."}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Account pet recovery copy clarification: Update sign-in screen header and body to explicitly explain that signing in preserves existing pets and cloud saves.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "body": "Use your registered account email to keep your pet settings and cloud sync active.", "hint": "Make sure to sign in with the email used when creating your pet."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo formatting guidance hint: Add explicit photo quality instructions on the photo upload screen regarding lighting and file formats.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use bright, front-facing photos in PNG or JPG format for accurate custom pet creation."}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Split path selection layout: Change path selection to a side-by-side split layout clearly distinguishing instant pre-made pets from custom pets.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Select Your Onboarding Experience", "body": "Adopt a ready-made companion instantly or create your own custom pet from photos."}}
7: [finish, layout] Spotlight introduction layout: Change home_intro layout to spotlight focus emphasizing desktop pet activation.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!", "body": "Click finish to launch your companion onto your screen."}}
8: [adoption, wait_info] Photo processing visual indicator: Display status text and progress bar during photo upload verification.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Verifying image facial features...", "style": "subtle"}]}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Clear intro expectation copy: Update story screen intro copy to set quick setup expectations for new desktop pet owners.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "In less than two minutes, bring a personal virtual companion directly to your computer screen.", "button_label": "Get Started"}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption preserves all required steps and is explicitly allowed under rule 4.
Redesigning the pet selection screen into a visual carousel preserves its primary job without violating any rules.
Adding a new tutorial screen inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4 and preserves all required steps.
Adding visual progress and actual wait time indicators to the waiting screen preserves its function and complies with rule 5.
Updating sign-in copy to clarify cloud save functionality is valid and does not mention pricing.
Adding photo guidance hints on the upload screen is a valid onboarding enhancement.
Split layout for path selection clearly offers both adopting pre-made pets and creating custom pets, maintaining screen job.
Redesigning home_intro layout stays inside onboarding bounds and preserves screen function.
Adding visual photo verification indicators to photo upload is allowed within onboarding.
Updating intro copy on the story screen introduces the pet concept without violating rules.
